mapper.select: SELECT FROM customer_address WHERE customer_id=CAST(#{owner} AS UNSIGNED) ORDER BY is_default DESC,id DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customer_address WHERE customer_id=CAST(#{owner} AS UNSIGNED)
SELECT FROM customer_address WHERE customer_id=CAST(#{owner} AS UNSIGNED) AND id=CAST(#{id} AS UNSIGNED)
SELECT FROM customer_address WHERE customer_id=CAST(#{owner} AS UNSIGNED) AND is_default=TRUE
mapper.update: UPDATE customer_address SET is_default=FALSE,version=version+1,updated_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE customer_id=CAST(#{owner} AS UNSIGNED) AND is_default=TRUE AND id != CAST(#{exceptId} AS UNSIGNED)
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM customer_address WHERE customer_id=CAST(#{owner} AS UNSIGNED) AND id=CAST(#{id} AS UNSIGNED)
